primaries.description: Higher alchemy skill allows you to learn higher level alchemy recipes.  Alchemy recipes can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and monsters.
primaries.name: Alchemy

primaries.description: Higher herbalism skill allows you to harvest more difficult herbs around the world.  If you cannot harvest a specific herb, then increase your skill by harvesting easier to gather herbs in lower level areas.
primaries.name: Herbalism

secondaries.description: Higher cooking skill allows you to learn higher level cooking recipes.  Recipes can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and as drops from monsters.
secondaries.name: Cooking

secondaries.description: Higher first aid skill allows you to learn higher level first aid abilities.  First aid abilities can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and as drops from monsters.
secondaries.name: First Aid

talents.description: Improves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%.
talents.name: Suppression

talents.description: Reduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by 2 sec and increases the damage it deals by 10%.
talents.name: Improved Corruption

talents.description: Increases all damage done by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter pets by 6%.
talents.name: Unholy Power
